scope: 24 distinct byte inputs, bulk-read settings and preview/reset choices used by the 96 importer selectors
precondition: A fresh owned stream and delegate for each observation. The supplied documents are ASCII, optionally preceded by one UTF-8 BOM.
postcondition: The remaining bytes, ordered UTF-16 units read on a separately opened original stream, and repeated EOF are recorded. Every decoded sequence must agree with independent UTF-8 decoding of the byte poststate. Any exception or missing case fails acquisition of the fact.
